Ivy (FinOps): Quick flag: QA found inconsistent line-item codes in proforma for bucket experiment. Some entries use `gen_text_v2` and some `generate_text_v2` which breaks reconciliation.
Rohan (Billing): Ugh. That's from the SKU normalization step. Thanks for catching. Can you paste an example row?
Ivy (FinOps): Example snippet: `customer,sku,units,amount
acct-123,gen_text_v2,3,$0.24
acct-456,generate_text_v2,2,$0.16`
Sienna (Product): We're shipping a small rename in the runtime. Should we map both to the same billing code for the experiment?
Derek (Eng): Easy fix: billing mapping table has alias column. I'll add `generate_text_v2` -> `gen_text_v2` entry and redeploy. Patch in PR: https://redwood-internal/pull/4521 (will link commit).
AuditBot: Audit note added: change-request 4521 by Derek.
Rohan (Billing): After deploy I'll re-generate proformas and re-run parser. If all good, we'll push previews.
Ivy (FinOps): Can we also add a lint step to the proforma pipeline to fail on unknown SKUs? Saves manual check.
Derek (Eng): Yep. Adding a lightweight schema check in the export job. Patch ETA 3 hours.
Sienna (Product): Thanks. Once fixed, can we unhold the 7 test proformas and proceed with the 5% cohort?
Rohan (Billing): Will confirm after re-run.
Ivy (FinOps): Great. Tag @Rohan when proformas are ready. :white_check_mark:
